text: The design concept will be developed on the smartboard during the session, with ID and ME creating a new page and contributing creative input, and the board being saved as part of the session tasks.
ID and ME will present the design to management.
There is uncertainty about the total project cost.
Decisions include settling on one overall shape, production in China, a target price of 25 Euro per piece, rubber material for the case, and the product name Real Remote.
